title: gentiana excisa subsp. alpina
intro: Gentiana excisa subsp. alpina, commonly known as Alpina gentian, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family, typically found in mountainous regions. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating digestive issues, providing relief from nausea and stomach problems. The bioactive constituents of Alpina gentian include gentiopicrin, gentianine, and loganin, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as being an anti-inflammatory and a carminative. The health benefits of Alpina gentian include its potential to aid in digestion and reduce stress due to its adaptogenic properties, although further research is needed to confirm these effects.
